3) People

- Do you want me to coordinate around specific attendees’ calendars (if so, what are their email addresses)?

4) Flexibility and constraints
- Are weekdays or weekends preferred?
- Any dates/times you definitely want to avoid?

Once I have these, I can check weather suitability for your date(s), suggest better alternatives if needed, and (if you want) place the event on calendars for your attendees.</action>
